subtitle: Concerning orcs and their settlement
recipient: To Magister Aldred of the Order of the Iron Sceptre,
preamble: Let it be known that the Count’s League and the Order of the Iron Sceptre, wishing to preserve peace and settle their respective claims within Castanor, agree to the following terms.
body:
Article I — Of the Castanorian Boundary
The parties recognize Inner Castanor as the principal sphere of the Count’s League and South Castanor as that of the Order of the Iron Sceptre.
Neither shall advance claims within the recognized sphere of the other except by mutual agreement.
Article II — Of Inner Castanor
The Order recognizes the claims of the Count’s League within Inner Castanor and shall neither contest them nor support another power against them.
Lands brought beneath the League’s authority within these bounds shall be recognized as falling within its lawful jurisdiction.
Article III — Of South Castanor
The Count’s League recognizes the Order’s claims within South Castanor and its custodianship of lands brought beneath its authority there, provided Articles IV and V are respected.
So long as these protections are upheld, the League shall neither contest those claims nor support another power against them.
Article IV — Of Corintar
The continued political existence of Corintar shall be respected.
Alliance, federation, protection, or vassalage shall not violate this accord, provided Corintar remains a distinct polity and is not annexed or extinguished.
Article V — Of Marrhold
The future disposition of Marrhold and Doewood shall remain reserved for further agreement between the parties.

The Order shall take no action altering their political status without prior consultation with and assent from the Count’s League.

This protection applies only to Marrhold and Doewood. Other lands held by the Kingdom of Marrhold remain subject to the Order’s recognized claims in South Castanor.
